record.reference: Transgenomic approved a 1-for-30 reverse split effective after the 2017-06-05 close, making 2017-06-06 the first post-split trading session. The frozen SEP witness is a constant zero-volume stale series whose adjustment-domain transitions are approximately 1/450 on 2017-06-06 and 15 on the first later traded identity row; their product is 1/30. The canonical share multiplier is the exact legal 1/30, not either isolated stale-domain transition.
